get.description:
Calculates the primary Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) based on the provided filters:
- **Share of Ink (SoI):** Total number of articles.
- **Share of Voice (SoV):** Sum of the source ranking for all articles, indicating media influence.
- **Total Social Shares:** Sum of all Facebook shares for the articles.

get.description:
Generates a daily briefing by fetching articles for a specific date (or today),
formatting them as context, and using the LLM to synthesize a report.

parameters.name: date

schema.description: Date in DD-MMM-YY format (e.g., 17-DEC-25). Defaults to today.
schema.title: Date

parameters.description: Date in DD-MMM-YY format (e.g., 17-DEC-25). Defaults to today.

get.description:
Returns every story cluster, ordered by creation date (newest first).
Each cluster groups articles about the same event or topic.

schema.title: Response List Clusters Api Explore Clusters Get

get.summary: Get articles belonging to a cluster
get.description:
Returns the cluster metadata and all articles assigned to it,
sorted by date descending.

get.summary: Get top 10 topics/entities mentioned in a cluster
get.description:
Returns the most-mentioned named entities (people, organisations,
locations, etc.) across all articles within the specified cluster,
ranked by mention count. Enriched with Wikipedia/Wikidata links when available.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Number of top topics to return
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Number of top topics to return

get.summary: Generate an LLM briefing for a specific date
get.description:
Given a date in DD-MMM-YY format (e.g. 17-DEC-25), fetch all articles
for that day and generate an LLM-synthesized intelligence briefing.

get.summary: Get top entities/topics mentioned on a given date
get.description:
Returns the most-mentioned named entities (people, organisations,
locations, etc.) across all articles published on the given date.
Enriched with Wikipedia/Wikidata links when available.

parameters.name: date

schema.description: Date in DD-MMM-YY format (e.g. 17-DEC-25)
schema.title: Date

parameters.description: Date in DD-MMM-YY format (e.g. 17-DEC-25)

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Number of top entities to return
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Number of top entities to return

get.summary: Get all articles mentioning an entity, sorted by date
get.description:
Returns every article that mentions the given entity (case-insensitive),
sorted by date descending.

post.summary: Regenerate LLM summaries for all existing clusters
post.description:
One-time backfill endpoint. Iterates over every cluster in the database,
fetches its articles, and regenerates the summary using the LLM.
Replaces the old 'Aggregated event involving...' summaries.
